HelpText:
AutoRetainer Mode:
- Enable all your characters that you want to cycle through for ocean fishing.
- On A Boat will always log into the character with the lowest fisher level.
- If you don't have enough characters with retainers running to end in PostProcess,
  setup your AutoRetainer to wait on Titlescreen.

Add characters by name and home world. Drag rows to change voyage order. One character stays logged in; multiple characters cycle in list order, one per voyage.

If you don't have completed the ocean fishing quest already, it will be done for you. (Requires Questionable)
StopAt: Stop if selected chars are lvl:
ManualCharactersHelp: Add characters by name and home world. Drag rows to change voyage order. One character stays logged in; multiple characters cycle in list order, one per voyage.
DiscardProviderHelp: AutoRetainer uses its discard rules. WahTools enables automatic discard after each voyage, respecting its Keep list, without desynth. WahTools handles cleanup travel; Henchman's return and dock selling are skipped. Use AutoRetainer discard with AR support.
UseARItemSellHelp: If you do not enable the option below, this will only work if you return to a destination with a retainer bell/vendor NPC nearby.
UseARLocalSell: Sell to the vendor at the docks
UseARLocalSellHelp: This will sell to the local vendor at the docks. High risk to stack with other botters, so be careful!
